subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated \u000B latency & throughput follow-up
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted vs Dedicated -- post-call recap

Thanks Eric -- great conversation today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment:

Call recap:
- Use case: real-time personalization for Acme's product detail pages (inference on ~512-token prompts).
- Latency requirement: target p95 <= 120ms for interactive flows, absolute max p95 150ms.
- Throughput: baseline expected ~180-220 QPS, promo spikes up to ~350-400 QPS for short windows.
- Security: standard enterprise controls; SOC 2 and VPC options will be important for procurement.

High-level recommendation:
- Given the latency and sustained throughput targets, Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) is the most likely path to meet p95 targets consistently.
- Hosted API can be a fast pilot (limited traffic) but may not hit p95 targets at peak QPS in your region without burst/dedicated nodes.

What I need from you to size a Dedicated PoC:
- Expected QPS split by route (e.g., personalization vs batch enrichment)
- Typical sequence lengths and average token counts
- Any strict network egress or data residency constraints

Next steps:
1) I can put together an initial sizing estimate (GPU pools, expected p95 ranges, ballpark pricing) -- attaching our SOC2 summary and perf benchmarks we've run for similar workloads.
2) Recommend a short follow-up (30-45m) with our infra lead Marissa to walk sizing and SLA commitments. Proposed times: Mon 4/19 10:00am PT or Tue 4/20 9:00am PT.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, perf-benchmarks-v1.pdf

Thanks -- I'll wait for the QPS/details and we'll move the sizing sheet to you.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks Neha -- this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:
- We want to go to market quickly, so a Hosted pilot would be attractive for the first 4-6 weeks, but we will likely require Dedicated for GA if latency can't be guaranteed.
- Updated numbers: baseline traffic ~200 QPS, promo peaks ~350 QPS (peaks last 10-15 minutes). Average prompt size ~450 tokens. p95 target 150ms (we can accept 120-150ms as a band).
- Procurement timeline: decision and PO target end of May. SOC2 and perf numbers will be required for the procurement pack.

Request: can you provide a short note on what SLA/latency commitments Redwood can make for Dedicated vs Hosted, and a very rough monthly cost estimate (ballpark) for Dedicated for the sizes you expect? Also OK with the sizing call -- Mon 4/19 10am PT works for our infra lead and me.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Wang <eric.wang@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-16T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated -- latency & throughput follow-up

Great -- thanks for the numbers, Eric. Short answers up front and then proposed plan:

SLA / latency commitments:
- Dedicated: we can commit to a latency SLO (service-level objective) for p95 on pinned model runtimes when the workload is placed on a Dedicated pool; exact SLA language is scoped in enterprise contracts and depends on model/quantization and sequence length -- we'll propose language for the contract. In practice we've hit p95 in the ~80-140ms range for 512-token runs on properly sized Dedicated pools in our US regions.
- Hosted: no hard latency SLA for public multi-tenant Hosted API; we offer prioritized routing/bursting for paid tiers but sustained p95 at 120-150ms at your scale is not guaranteed on Hosted alone.

Initial sizing (engineering estimate) -- assumptions: 450-512 token prompts, mixture of short and medium sequences, baseline 200 QPS, peaks 350 QPS:
- Recommendation: Dedicated pool equivalent to ~4x A100-class GPUs (multi-node pool) as a starting point for predictable p95 under 150ms. This should support baseline + burst with autoscaling headroom.
- Pilot option: Hosted pilot (limited traffic up to ~60k requests/day) to validate model correctness and integration while we stand up Dedicated capacity for GA.

Ballpark monthly cost: will provide a formal quote during the sizing call -- rough order of magnitude for a 4x A100-equivalent Dedicated pool is included in the pricing sheet I'll bring to the call (will vary by reserved commitment term).

I'm attaching a short sizing spreadsheet (initial-sizing-sheet.xlsx) and a draft mutual action plan link -- we can iterate on both on Monday. Confirmed: Mon 4/19 10:00am PT for the sizing session with Marissa.

Best,
Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
